items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: We all remember Abbie, I remember Jerry and Merritt. We all started together.

ctx.x: I had black. Some of them connected up with metal, little metal.

I had when Al Rose wanted to let him have it. Because of Italy. And Abbie played on the thing all night on the block. Where's Abbie at? Across the lake. Across the lake. We all remember Abbie, I remember Jerry and Merritt. We all started together.
Did you ever play in Papa Lane's band? No, no.
